text:
kai: Quick final sync for Fri launch — must-haves: changelog link, docs preview (runnable snippets), short benchmark bullets for the blog (p50/p95 + token cost delta), webinar CTA, and HubSpot routing by EOD. Embargo 13:00 UTC. Can eng confirm rollout windows and the benchmark numbers? @mira
mira: On it. Canary plan draft: 3% x 10m -> 15% x 25m -> 50% x 30m -> 100%. Abort if 5xx > 0.9% OR p95 latency > 320ms. Benchmarks from staging runs: p50=78ms, p95=215ms, median token time down ~11% vs baseline, estimated token cost reduction ~9% for our RLHF pipeline. Will post the raw numbers + histogram link in 10m.
fern: Docs preview ready: https://docs.redwood.ai/previews/214. Includes curl + node quickstarts, embeddings example, and a small migration note. I can swap model name once you confirm. Also added a short FAQ about version pinning.
kai: Great — marketing needs the 2-3 bullet benchmark copy we can drop into the blog header (super short). Also need the changelog commit hash to link in the announce.
mira: Use these two bullets for blog header: \u2022 p95 reduced to ~215ms on our long-context benchmark; \u2022 token cost down ~9% for RLHF-style workloads via smarter batching + adaptive prefix cache. Changelog draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/commit/zxy987. Blurb: "Improved batching and adaptive prefix caching to lower tail latency and token cost for long-context workloads."
eldar: For inbound, use HubSpot tag `launch_nov_fri` (no spaces). Routing: tag -> marketing/sdr queue; escalate to sales if usage > 60 reqs/day OR trial created within 12h. I'll paste rule IDs into the GTM ops doc after this thread. Also confirm webinar reg URL can go into CTA.
kai: Webinar landing: https://redwood.ai/webinar/serve-fast. Marketing timeline: blog T+0 (13:15 UTC), social bursts at +10/+60, webinar CTA in blog, and a follow-up nurture email at T+24h. Can we get a 20m dry-run 30m before publish?
mira: Yes dry-run at 12:45 UTC. I'll run health checks and demo the canary dashboard. Checklist: canary traffic, p50/p95, error rate, top traces, and rollback commands (I'll paste them here).
fern: I'll rehearse the quickstart and live snippet at the dry-run. I'll also ensure docs permalink is stable: https://docs.redwood.ai/previews/214#final once we get final model string.
eldar: HubSpot rule IDs: marketing/queue/4102; escalation webhook id 9982. I'll add the UTM template: utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=nov_launch
webhook-bot: [deploy-schedule] canary requested by mira for 2026-11-05T12:30:00Z
kai: One last ask — marketing needs a 1-line quote from eng about impact (for the header). Mira?
mira: "This release reduces tail latency and token cost for long-context inference by combining smarter batching with an adaptive prefix cache, making production inference faster and cheaper." Use as-is.
kai: Perfect. I'll lock the blog draft and schedule the embargo ping T-30m in #marketing. :rocket:
